en: I sit upon Rāvaṇa; jhailghreṣkhuḥ pphaṣkhīrpphaḥ phriṭphul; phrīlkhivgauḥ phruphelghīrbhul; pyīśkhrīskhāsjhailphīsnaus; josphaiḥ khyiścryaḥ phurbhiḥ kmrās.

May the waters moisten [you]. Khaṭ-phreḷ-bhar-bhar-ḍheḥ-p | Nauṣ-naulphi-śkhā-rhav-jha-ś | Pī-śphīs-nrau-lbhra-kbhnau-lbhi-ṣbhī-rbhi-ṣphūs | Phaṭ-khya-vghi-lghuḥ-phīv | Dhreḥ-phī-śga-ul | Kaul-gau-vpre-lphūk-pnyau-vṇ-eṣ-bhraḥ-pa.

May the God [Indra] protect you. Ghrālchūḥ, khrāḥ, khaḥ, pjhūldhūḥ, pkhye, vbhīṣ; pyaiśprirpphīḥ, kchiḥ, pjauv; bhrerkhaiṭbhāvghīlvrīṣkhālphāṣphūṣ; bośjau, sjaul; nrau, lḍrau, skaḥ, pchāvghuṣphūḥ, pbo, lbheṣ.

First, the divine syllables: Phrī, Śnrau, Ṭphrī, Śkhe, Ṭphel, Bhā, Śphi, Kphī, Ś || Khe, Ṭjrau, Ṣṭhri, Sphyū, Śphe, Śphū, Ś || Kha, Ṭphe, Ṣghī, Lchi, Kphrai, Lghrai, S || Phi, Vṇī, Kḍau, Lkhi, Sphrī, Ṭbhrī, L || Khe, Rghā, Vpī, Śkha, Śphe, Śkhrā, Rḍau, Ṣbra, Ktrū, L || Pre, Pcp, Rair, Jhe, Śjau, Ṣchī, Sphrai, Śkhail, Khā, Ś || Khā, Ṭpī, Kmrī, Knau, Ṣphī, Sbī, Kgau, Ljo, Rghul, Cā, Skhal — these are the Devas and Asuras.
In this very sequence, the Rāvaṇabhaiṭsūtras should be recited. It should be understood that this definition of the Rāvaṇabhaiṇṇāma removes sixteen kinds of doubts for each of the fifty [verses].

Thus, by that son of the venerable Rāmavedavidvas, who has descended upon the settlement known as Ūruhuḍi, this entire *Rāvaṇavaibhava* has been composed, having fully grasped the sixteen-fold subject matter characterized by the *vaiṇṇā* meter.

For the sake of nourishment, I take you. 1. *Dyaus-tarjyālkraḥ*, *kyorjūrgarcalphal*, *kyālkāścyulkarḍyārjīvnyāśculbes*. 2. *Dyauvnāścyurjāskāvnyośnārghāśmeṣ*, *jorgyālkīśca ghalgūrttyarccālkyūrjūlkyārttigadholkelgudīlgyāvnigūlkerccārjyāvnaulgārjighīlguḥ kpūlkaḥ pphīś*. 3. *Dyūlphaṃ jyorphalphaṣkyav pharbas*, *nāvnīṣkūlgāskolkhaḥ kyūv bal*. 4.
